name: zfmv_action_play_mci_destructor
description: zFMV_ActionPlayMci::Destructor frees the optional media path, destroys and deletes the optional playback object, clears both owned pointers, restores the base action vtable, and returns.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayMci/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463c10 validates the thiscall destructor shape: install the PlayMci vtable, free mediaPath when non-null and clear it, call zFMV_Playback::Destructor and operator delete for playback when non-null and clear it, install the base zFMV action vtable, and return.

The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_Playback::Destructor is functional-equivalent and free, operator delete, and compiler EH glue are provider-boundary dependencies for the functional lane.
The native smoke verifies mediaPath release and clearing, playback destructor/delete and clearing, final base vtable identity, and null-owned-pointer paths.
